heroHeadline: Vera C. Rubin Observatory Begins Its Ten-Year Survey of the Universe
heroSubtitle: LSST science operations continue from Cerro Pachón, Chile — the 3,200-megapixel LSST Camera is capturing a new image roughly every 40 seconds, having logged over 11,000 new asteroids and ~380 trans-Neptunian objects. Analysis of Early Data Preview 2 has now yielded the survey's first confirmed extragalactic find: Aquarius IV, an ultra-faint Milky Way satellite galaxy, reported in an August 2026 preprint. A second EDP2 data phase remains due Q4 2026.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
